title: 2025 Pokémon TCG Cottonee (Master Ball Pattern) 007 Prismatic Evolutions Holo
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Pokémon TCG card featuring Cottonee from the Prismatic Evolutions set. This English card has a Master Ball pattern Holo finish and is part of the Basic stage. It is a common card with 60 HP and is illustrated by Kyoko Umemoto. The card is made of card stock and was manufactured by The Pokémon Company in the United States. With its rarity and unique design, this collectible card is a must-have for any Pokémon TCG enthusiast.
